title: Petual, which automates internal audit work and generates auditor-ready workpapers, raised $20M across a pre-seed led by First Round and a seed led by a16z (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Petual, which automates internal audit work and generates auditor-ready workpapers, raised $20M across a pre-seed led by First Round and a seed led by a16z — - Other backers include Cowboy Ventures, Lachy Groom, the founders of Lyft and Opendoor, and other angels.
